title: Annual General Meeting
description: Hold the AGM within six months of the close of the financial year (nine months for the first AGM after incorporation).
penalty_note: Company and every officer in default liable to fine; NCLT may extend by up to three months on application.

title: Annual Return (MGT-7)
description: File the annual return within sixty days of the AGM.
penalty_note: Additional fee per day of delay; s.92(5) penalty on company and officers.

title: Abridged Annual Return (MGT-7A)
description: Small companies and OPCs file the abridged annual return within sixty days of the AGM (or of the date the AGM was due, for an OPC).

title: Filing of Financial Statements (AOC-4)
description: File the audited financial statements within thirty days of the AGM.
penalty_note: Additional fee per day of delay; s.137(3) penalty on company and officers.

title: Filing of Financial Statements in XBRL (AOC-4 XBRL)
description: Listed companies and companies crossing the prescribed capital or turnover thresholds file financial statements in XBRL format.
source_ref: Companies (Filing of Documents and Forms in XBRL) Rules, 2015 r.3
penalty_note: Threshold-based applicability (capital and turnover) is evaluated from ledger facts in Phase 4; the listed test is the only one applied today.

title: Notice of Auditor Appointment (ADT-1)
description: Intimate the appointment of the statutory auditor within fifteen days of the AGM at which the appointment was made.

title: Director KYC (DIR-3 KYC)
description: Every person holding a DIN as at 31 March must complete KYC by 30 September of that year.
source_ref: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014 r.12A
penalty_note: DIN deactivated on default; reactivation fee payable. LLPs are covered by the separate LLP-KYC rule so an LLP does not get both.

title: Return of Deposits (DPT-3)
description: File the annual return of deposits and of money received that is not treated as a deposit, by 30 June.

title: Half-yearly Return of MSME Dues — April to September (MSME-1)
description: Report outstanding dues to micro and small enterprises exceeding forty-five days, for the half-year ended 30 September, by 31 October.
source_ref: MCA Order dated 22 January 2019 under s.405

title: Half-yearly Return of MSME Dues — October to March (MSME-1)
description: Report outstanding dues to micro and small enterprises exceeding forty-five days, for the half-year ended 31 March, by 30 April.
source_ref: MCA Order dated 22 January 2019 under s.405

title: Reconciliation of Share Capital Audit — first half (PAS-6)
description: Unlisted public companies file the share-capital reconciliation for the half-year ended 30 September within sixty days of its close.
source_ref: Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Rules, 2014 r.9A(8)

title: Reconciliation of Share Capital Audit — second half (PAS-6)
description: Unlisted public companies file the share-capital reconciliation for the half-year ended 31 March within sixty days of its close.
source_ref: Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Rules, 2014 r.9A(8)

title: Report on Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR-2)
description: Companies to which s.135 applies file the CSR report for the preceding financial year.
penalty_note: Applicability is threshold-driven (net worth, turnover or net profit). Phase 1 flags it for every company; Phase 4 evaluates the thresholds from ledger facts.

title: Return of Significant Beneficial Owners (BEN-2)
description: File the return of significant beneficial owners within thirty days of receiving a BEN-1 declaration.

title: Minimum four board meetings in the year
description: Hold at least four board meetings each year with no more than one hundred and twenty days between consecutive meetings.
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.173(1); Secretarial Standard SS-1

title: Minimum two board meetings in the year (small / OPC / dormant)
description: One Person Companies, small companies and dormant companies hold at least one board meeting in each half of the year, with at least ninety days between them.

title: First board meeting within thirty days of incorporation
description: Hold the first meeting of the Board within thirty days of the date of incorporation.

title: Annual Disclosure of Interest by Directors (MBP-1)
description: Every director discloses their concern or interest at the first board meeting of the financial year, and whenever it changes.
source_ref: Companies (Meetings of Board and its Powers) Rules, 2014 r.9(1)

title: Annual Declaration of Non-disqualification (DIR-8)
description: Every director declares annually that they are not disqualified from acting as a director.
source_ref: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014 r.14(1)

title: Board's Report
description: Prepare and approve the Board's Report, with its annexures, for attachment to the financial statements.

title: Secretarial Audit Report (MR-3)
description: Listed companies and companies crossing the prescribed thresholds annex a secretarial audit report to the Board's Report.
source_ref: Companies (Appointment and Remuneration of Managerial Personnel) Rules, 2014 r.9

title: Maintenance of statutory registers
description: Keep the registers of members, directors, KMP, charges and related-party contracts up to date at the registered office.

title: LLP Annual Return (Form 11)
description: File the LLP annual return within sixty days of the close of the financial year.
penalty_note: Additional fee of Rs. 100 per day, without cap.

title: LLP Statement of Account and Solvency (Form 8)
description: File the statement of account and solvency within thirty days from the end of six months of the financial year.
penalty_note: Additional fee of Rs. 100 per day, without cap.

title: Designated Partner KYC (DIR-3 KYC)
description: Designated partners holding a DPIN complete KYC by 30 September each year.
source_ref: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014 r.12A

title: Change in Directors or KMP (DIR-12)
description: File particulars of appointment, change or cessation of directors and key managerial personnel within thirty days of the event.

title: Change of Registered Office (INC-22)
description: Notify a change in the situation of the registered office within thirty days of the change.

title: Filing of Resolutions and Agreements (MGT-14)
description: File the prescribed resolutions and agreements within thirty days of passing.

title: Return of Allotment (PAS-3)
description: File the return of allotment within thirty days of the allotment of securities.

title: Alteration of Share Capital (SH-7)
description: Notify an alteration of the authorised share capital within thirty days of the resolution.

title: Registration of Charge (CHG-1)
description: Register the creation or modification of a charge within thirty days of its creation.

title: Satisfaction of Charge (CHG-4)
description: Report the satisfaction of a charge within thirty days of payment or satisfaction in full.

title: Filing of Court or Tribunal Order (INC-28)
description: File a certified copy of an order of a court or tribunal within the period the order specifies.
